audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3-5].side say 'Skill' while content win[3-5] and packet.levelChart say Braum wins those stages; phases[6].side says 'Skill' while win[6]/packet say Yuumi wins late.
audit.why: Chart disagrees with the prose underneath it for four of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[3-5].side to Braum and phases[6].side to Yuumi, adjusted ratings, and rewrote each .why to match content whys[].

audit.why: Spikes correctly key to level-2 detach punish, level-6 R vs R mismatch, first-item front-line spike, and Yuumi's late scaling window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three missingInteractions never surface: Glacial Fissure's grounding denies You and Me! (W); Final Chapter (R) is an interruptible channel; Yuumi's Q/W apply on-hit so pure armor undersells the trade.
audit.why: All three are concrete, matchup-specific counterplay the page currently omits.
audit.corrected: Added two Do's/Don'ts entries covering the R-denial/interrupt and the on-hit itemization point.

audit.why: You and Me! actually has 0 cooldown (mana-gated only) which is itself the key fact — the field currently says nothing about it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with the real W mana-gating and R's 120/110/100s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t and report[9].t use 'his'/'him' for Yuumi, who is she/her.
dosFull[1] (titled 'Count to four with your carry') and dontsFull[2] (titled 'Wall reactively at half value') contain tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to match their titles.

edits.before: Stack the margins — every traded auto is a quarter-stun; their math hates it.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you keep forcing fights while she lacks peel and CC.

edits.before: Glacial Fissure online — the line knockup starts dives and ends theirs.
edits.after: Your level 6 knockup ult dwarfs her purely zoning Final Chapter.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: First item makes you an unkillable frontline she can't out-heal.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: By 2+ items her scaling enables her ADC and flips the lane.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Unbreakable banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - You and Me! (W) has no cooldown, only a mana cost — she can re-attach instantly, so track her mana bar, not a timer. - Final Chapter (R) is 120/110/100s and a channel — Concussive Blows or Glacial Fissure landing cancels it outright. - Keep Unbreakable (E) for her all-in window, not routine chip.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on You and Me! (Attach)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on your first item spike and with your carry’s damage online — her W has no cooldown to wait out, so force the fight instead. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Every auto you and your ADC land stacks Concussive Blows — keep landing autos through her E shield; the fourth hit stuns regardless.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Unbreakable only blocks from one direction — raising it after her Q has already landed wastes the whole cast.
Save Glacial Fissure to deny You and Me!
Your R's grounding shuts off her W dash to an ally — hold it for her engage attempt, not for poke.
Assume armor alone solves her poke
Prowling Projectile (Q) and You and Me! (W) both apply on-hit and scale with attack speed — pure armor undersells the trade.

notes: Chart-vs-prose disagreement on 4 of 7 rows (3, 4, 5 flat-templated 'Skill' when Braum already won per win[]/packet, and 6 flat-templated 'Skill' when Yuumi already won late per win[]/packet) — same defect pattern as the mirror champions in this lane.
